load_exr_image: load an EXR image file from disk using OpenCV and convert BGR to RGB color space
save_tensor_as_png: save a PyTorch tensor as a PNG image file with automatic channel handling and RGB to BGR conversion
convert_depth_to_normal: compute a surface normal map from a depth tensor and camera intrinsics matrix using cross product
interpolate_camera_pose: interpolate camera pose and exposure gain between two camera parameter dicts at a given timestamp
calculate_ssim_difference_map: calculate the SSIM difference map between two single-channel images using a Gaussian window
